desc:
Use your trusty magnet to steal mountains of treasure and giant eggs from sea monsters - just don't wake them up! 
⚠️ Explore 10 ocean regions with their own unique treasures, environments, and dangers!
🐟 Discover over 400 unique fish, eggs, hats, treasures, legendary Paragons, and more!
🧬 Merge, mutate and evolve fish to create new life! 
🌀 Do it all again and Rebirth to summon Wyrms with epic abilities!
🖌️ Relax with hand-painted UI and a chill soundtrack...?
